name: WordPress and WooCommerce speed fixes
goal: A working, reversible store-speed change supported by paired measurements and buying-flow checks, or an explicit decision to keep the baseline when the candidate fails. Publishing stays within existing exact authority.
starts_from: A slow mobile shopping journey, a deployment regression, a platform update or a customer complaint backed by a URL and available source.
metrics: Declare the primary lab metric, minimum useful improvement and regression limits before any comparison.
Field p75 LCP, INP and CLS retain URL/origin scope and observation windows; lab TBT is not INP.
Cart, session, checkout, content, accessibility, consent and analytics checks remain release guardrails.

stages.name: Ground the platform and the job
stages.say: Inventory WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, theme and plugin versions, hosting, database and every cache layer. Distinguish blocks and classic checkout. Check mini-cart and other dependencies before unloading scripts; protect private routes and personalized endpoints from shared caches. Read approved brand context and scoped memory. Use existing access without asking again; name missing dependencies while continuing useful local work.
needs: target URLs, source revision and existing access scope
stages.done_when: The source map matches URLs, assets and versions; the platform owner and permitted draft/release scope are explicit.

stages.name: Record the baseline and test protocol
stages.say: Use role-scoped official sources and field data with dates. Inspect LCP, response and resource timing, CPU and layout evidence before choosing a cause. Capture a trace if load completes far before first paint. Predeclare a practical threshold; preserve failed runs and uncertainty.
stages.done_when: The protocol defines metrics, limits, paired order, browser/device/network/CPU/cache conditions and commerce checks before a candidate is measured.

stages.name: Build one reversible candidate
stages.say: Create the smallest justified patch on a branch or restorable staging copy. Preserve visible product content and buyer state. Record changed bytes and dependencies, restore steps and why this targets the measured cause. Never change browser flags or release thresholds to make a failing patch pass.
stages.done_when: The patch applies to the named revision, backup/restore is practical and unrelated content or platform settings remain unchanged.

stages.name: Compare speed and buying behavior
stages.say: Run at least five paired baseline/candidate comparisons in alternating order under the predeclared conditions. Keep all raw reports and errors. Test affected navigation, search, product variants, prices, stock, cart persistence, consent and checkout entry with isolated sessions. Use only an authorized non-charging test checkout path. A suspected compositor stall remains inconclusive unless independent evidence resolves it.
stages.done_when: The comparison states measured improvement, regression or inconclusive; missing or failed functionality prevents a release recommendation.

stages.name: Verify authority and release the tested revision
stages.say: Review the exact patch, measurements and rollback together. Reuse already granted release authority; request only genuinely missing scope. If the candidate loses or evidence is inconclusive, retain the baseline and record why. For an authorized passing candidate, deploy the tested revision and verify its live bytes and buying journey.
needs: existing authorization for the exact release
stages.done_when: A passing authorized revision is verified live, or the baseline is explicitly retained with the failed evidence and next step.
stages.publish: Deploy only the checked revision through the existing authorized repository/hosting or WordPress deployment connection; keep the rollback artifact available.

stages.name: Check real shoppers and keep the learning
stages.say: Recheck comparable field windows when available, reporting page versus origin scope and traffic-mix changes. Preserve customer complaints and recurring friction. Save this stack/revision-specific episode and failed candidates; promote only corroborated findings to a dated playbook. Arrange recurring checks only when requested.
needs: dated CrUX/RUM and permitted commercial data
stages.done_when: The record distinguishes lab results, field observations and hypotheses, and retains unresolved customer problems rather than hiding them behind a score.

scope.passes_when: The target, stack, brand constraints, source/revision identity, missing inputs and existing authority are explicit; unrelated platforms are routed to the right specialist.

measurement.passes_when: The installed specialist pack tool reviews at least five alternating complete pairs with identical environments, raw evidence and functional PASS. Only IMPROVED_LAB supports a lab win; it never certifies release or sales uplift.

commerce.passes_when: Evidence verifies affected shopping actions, isolated customer state, accessibility and consent on the exact candidate; no charged orders or shared private cache responses were used.

release.passes_when: The tested artifact matches the proposed release, existing exact permission is recorded, rollback is ready and no failed or inconclusive result is described as a proven improvement.

field.passes_when: Field sources and dates are linked, missing URL data is explicit, changed traffic mix is considered and lab changes are not presented as causal revenue uplift.
